notes: A deleted tag's NAME stays reserved: re-creating returns 'Tag with this name already exists' even though it appears in no list; retry with a distinct name.
DELETE answers 200 with the full deleted Tag entity as the body (unlike e.g. deleteExpense, which is empty-bodied).
Omitting archived returns archived AND active rows; only archived=false restricts to active.
Last-Page response header is authoritative for pagination; page-size is the hyphenated v1 spelling.
Request body is an inline object {archived?: boolean, name?: string} with no component-schema name.
PUT is a proven FULL REPLACE: omitting archived resets it to false — a name-only body silently un-archives an archived tag. Always resend archived.
